text: Yes, the JRC map indirectly corroborates the 2023 loss. The JRC 2020 reference shows the event area was fully forested in 2020, meeting the corroboration rule requirement. Hansen GFC detected 0.7 ha of tree-cover loss in 2023, though 0.4 ha was in patches below the 0.5 ha minimum threshold. The loss occurred in planted forest (Eucalyptus), not native forest. The JRC 2020 baseline confirms the area’s forested status pre-2023, supporting the observed loss event.
